newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Intria to buy Trenergy stake.
newsitem.headline: Intria to buy Trenergy stake.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure developer Intria Bhd on Wednesday proposed to buy a 30.89 percent equity interest in Trenergy Malaysia Bhd for 147.37 million ringgit or at 7.0 ringgit a share.
The national Bernama news agency quoted an Intria statement as saying that Intria had on Wednesday entered into an agreement for the planned acquisition of the oil-industry engineering firm.
Trenergy shares on Wednesday jumped 30 cents to 6.40 ringgit. Intria shares fell eight cents to 3.38.
The acquisition, which will be financed by borrowings and internal resources, will enable Intria to diversify and tap into opportunities in the oil and gas sector, the statement said.
The acquisition is subject to approvals from the Foreign Investment Committee, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry, the Securities Commission and Trenergy shareholders.
